Package org.tasktide.engine.observer.worker

Class StateObserver<T extends TaskTideModel<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.observer.worker.StateObserver<T>
Type Parameters:
T - of TaskTideModel-WorkItem,ItemTask
All Implemented Interfaces:
WorkerObserver<T>, TaskTideWorkerUnit<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ItemTaskStateObserver, WorkItemStateObserver
public abstract class StateObserver<T extends TaskTideModel<T>> extends Object implements WorkerObserver<T>
Abstract class for handling the logic of WorkItem/ItemTask processing based on states.

Would be useful to work towards embedding a TaskTideService, so progress logged.
